about: The secreta of the formulary “Holy Family of Jesus, Mary, and Joseph” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We offer unto Thee, O Lord, a sacrifice of propitiation, humbly beseeching that through the intercession of the Virgin Mother of God together with blessed Joseph Thou wouldst firmly establish our families in Thy peace and grace. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
g: suppliantly, in an attitude of humble entreaty
